11074|650fd33a.name: Hgarth
11074|650fd33a.text: You have reached new heights in your path to mastery. Let us see if we can take you even further...

11074|ccedb517.name: Hgarth
11074|ccedb517.text: There is only one whose skills exceed my own. You are ready to receive her knowledge. She is Annora, and you may find her... in Uldaman.

14729|9e055276.name: Ralston Farnsley
14729|9e055276.text:
You there... it is in your best interest to aid the Forsaken during these dire times.  Listen closely, as I dislike repeating myself.

We currently find ourselves in a dire shortage of cloth.  Bandages and simple textiles are running low, and donations are being accepted to bolster sagging inventories.  While you'll not receive financial compensation - hence what donation means - your aid will not go unnoticed.

2388|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Shay
2388|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

2389|c5ceacbe.name: Zarise
2389|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

253136|4b1452fc.name: Orgrul
253136|4b1452fc.text: Why do you approach me, outsider?

269152|644ccfaa.name: Tylana Clawhoof
269152|644ccfaa.text: You are not known to my people.  A kodo is a mighty steed, and it is the product of love and care by my people; such is not given onto strangers.  Until the elders of Thunder Bluff consider you to be exalted, I cannot offer you the sale of a kodo.

3309|2f8d506f.name: Karus
3309|2f8d506f.text: Besides the Grunts outside, my brothers and I fought at the battle of Hyjal. Any who seek to steal from the bank must face us first.

3309|6b36598f.name: Karus
3309|6b36598f.text: I guarantee this bank's security with my own blood, is that good enough for you?

3310|cc0cf280.name: Doras
3310|cc0cf280.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

3325|031480cd.name: Mirket
3325|031480cd.text: You know enough to be dangerous, but you still look like you need training to me $N.

3325|8fca8484.name: Mirket
3325|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

3345|75a71456.name: Godan
3345|75a71456.text: Your skills are out of my league, stranger.Talk to Hgarth at the Sun Rock Retreat in the Stonetalon Mountains. He will provide you with more knowledge than I can.

4312|c5ceacbe.name: Tharm
4312|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

4551|d37b59d0.name: Michael Garrett
4551|d37b59d0.text: How may I be of service?

4565|8fca8484.name: Richard Kerwin
4565|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

4565|db7f8bbb.name: Richard Kerwin
4565|db7f8bbb.text: It is wise that you humble yourself before me $N in your desire for more $c knowledge.

5398|87006095.name: Warug
5398|87006095.text: If you are here to fight, then good! You will see that the Magram are the strongest!

6726|c5ceacbe.name: Thalon
6726|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

1371-progress.name: Warug
1371-progress.text: If you are not our enemy, then you will do what I ask!
1371-progress.title: Gizmo for Warug

7813-progress.name: Ralston Farnsley
7813-progress.text:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by the Undercity for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7813-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

92743-complete.name: Warug
92743-complete.text:
Look at this! Look at it! What a crown! Befitting of a Khan... but to be worn by Warug. I am pleased.

Are you ready to learn the Magram's newest weapon against our foes?
92743-complete.title: A Conqueror's Crown

92754-accept.name: Mirda
92754-accept.text:
Our clanmates continue to venture further south, to and beyond the cursed Valley of Bones.

Despite your standing with our clan, I do not trust you enough to share the details of their ventures. They would be boring to you anyway, outsider.

What matters to you is our need for Greater Shadow Protection Potions, in bulk, to ensure their continued survival. Bring some to me, and I will put in a good word for you.
92754-accept.title: A New Need for Shadow Protection

92811-progress.name: Gorhak
92811-progress.text:
One thing that war has taught us: money is power.

All centaur in Desolace have come to an agreement to barter with intricately carved wood that shares tales of a centaur's own glory and conquests. It serves as the only reprieve from battle, and only the most level-headed are permitted to engage with other clans.

I have seen your kind trade in gold and silver. Worthless to us, as our totems are to you. Bring me some, and the Magram Clan will be pleased.
92811-progress.title: Economic Warfare

92841-accept.name: Warug
92841-accept.text:
It is time, outsider, for you to learn of our great discovery... but Warug will not be the one to tell it!

Head south to the other end of the village. Look for a big, stinky centaur named Orgrul.

You will know when you get there.
You will know when you see him.
If he thinks you deserve to know, you will know.

And if he doesn't? Well. You can be happy knowing Warug has a new crown.
92841-accept.title: Valley of Bones

92841-complete.name: Orgrul
92841-complete.text:
So the rumors are true. Unfortunate that Warug has had you running around with frivolous tasks. At least you proved your worth.

Peer down into the valley below, what do you see? Bones and bodies. Roaming $r. And the Twin Goliaths.

This place was cursed long before our arrival, and I suspect it will remain as such for many generations to come. Our clan was the first to brave the horrors below, and ours will be the only one to claim its power.

Are you as eager as I to rule over all of Desolace?
92841-complete.title: Valley of Bones

92844-accept.name: Orgrul
92844-accept.text:
Some sort of necromantic energy has permeated throughout the Valley of Bones, for reasons we have yet to understand.

Those reasons are also of no importance to us. The magic is ours now, and those who do not fight with blade or mallet are trained in this new magic.

If you think I intend to start you off with a challenging task, think again. For now, go into the Valley of Bones and fetch some bones for me. I am sure you can handle that.
92844-accept.title: Mountain of Bones

92844-complete.name: Orgrul
92844-complete.text:
<Orgrul begins to count the bones, but begins to skip numbers as they gain a second digit and eventually loses count. He tries a second time, but glares your direction partway through when your expression contorts while observing.>

Bah. I will count them later. This looks like enough. You had best not be deceiving me.

I will hold onto these.
92844-complete.title: Mountain of Bones

92844-progress.name: Orgrul
92844-progress.text: For every bone short you are for the task, I will take one of yours to make up the difference.
92844-progress.title: Mountain of Bones

92846-accept.name: Orgrul
92846-accept.text:
Have you noticed the puny centaur stomping about around here? Those are of Gelkis descent.

We Magram have already established a foothold deeper into the canyon. When the Gelkis took notice of our presence here, some among them chose to follow in our footsteps. I know not whether they wish to join us or attempt to overthrow us, but I do know that their clanmates have sentenced them all to exile.

They're lone wolves meddling in powers that do not belong to them. I want them dead.
92846-accept.title: Outcast Necromancers

92846-complete.name: Orgrul
92846-complete.text:
Bwahaha, I heard their cries from here!

The Gelkis ought to learn to slaughter their own kin who betray their heritage. Failing to do so puts the burden on us to clean up their mess, and I am not here to tidy up after an inferior clan.

If you see more, be sure to snuff out the lights in their eyes. Once a Gelkis, always a Gelkis.
92846-complete.title: Outcast Necromancers

92847-accept.name: Orgrul
92847-accept.text:
Outsider, did you notice the weapon that the outcast necromancers held in their hands? We will ensure the Gelkis will not live long enough to master the ways of necromancy, but their methods of channeling caught my interest. They even use those same crystals Warug asked you to steal.

I think we can use this technique to our advantage. Venture back into the valley to recover some wood from the accursed trees, and see if Warug will part with some of his crystals. I will make staves from them.
92847-accept.title: Corrupting Tears

92847-complete.name: Orgrul
92847-complete.text:
Only three? Hmmph, Warug is being stingy as always. Give me a moment while I create the staves.

I will take one. The second will go to the Necrokhan that patrols along the chokepoint toward the elven ruins.

The third is yours. You are a part of this war, now more than ever.
92847-complete.title: Corrupting Tears

92847-progress.name: Orgrul
92847-progress.text: These staves may be the missing piece we need to secure the rest of the Valley of Bones. Go now, $r, let us make use of the Gelkis' ways before their next discovery.
92847-progress.title: Corrupting Tears

92873-accept.name: Orgrul
92873-accept.text:
We already know these crystals are capable of more than sundering the ground--the Gelkis have proven that they can be twisted for necromantic power. Do you remember the bones I had you collect? I assembled them as best I could just up the hill. There was enough for two workable skeletons.

<Orgrul hands you a newly made staff.>

I will deliver the Necrokhan's staff while you play with your new toy. Return only once you can prove that you know how to use it.
92873-accept.title: Proof of Concept

92873-complete.name: Orgrul
92873-complete.text:
I can see a new fire burn brightly in your eyes, outsider. You have demonstrated your ability to create your own armaments, summon minions to do your bidding, and most importantly to assert your dominance when they refuse to follow your command.

A shame you have no centaur blood in you. You would be well on your way to become the next Khan.
92873-complete.title: Proof of Concept

92873-progress.name: Orgrul
92873-progress.text: Despite your aid thus far, if you are unable to raise the dead then your usefulness with the Magram has come to an end.
92873-progress.title: Proof of Concept

92893-accept.name: Orgrul
92893-accept.text:
As you tread further into the Valley of Bones, you will find Gelkis wanderers that dared to enter our territory. I instructed they be kept alive so they could feed the bone worms burrowing about, but they seem uninterested in their prey being alive.

This task is simple. Find the prisoners, then snuff out their life. Don't give them a brief glimmer of hope for freedom.
92893-accept.title: No Mercy for the Weak

92893-complete.name: Orgrul
92893-complete.text:
As much as I would have loved to hang their skulls from my tent, their bodies are far more valuable to the Magram left in the valley.

The bone worms will devour their flesh by the next morning, and we will have many new skeletons to raise thereafter.

With each Gelkis death, the Magram army grows stronger!
92893-complete.title: No Mercy for the Weak

92894-accept.name: Orgrul
92894-accept.text:
I can see the excitement in your eyes, outsider. Do you grasp the potential of necromancy yet?

Of course you do. And that is why I am ordering you to hone your skills further.

As you venture deeper into the Valley of Bones, you will see the remains of failed attempts at raising the dead. Gelkis attempts, no doubt. Hardly able to claw out from the dirt. Funny, were it not so pathetic.

I have imbued your staff with greater power. Use this to grow our army, and crush the ones that fight back!
92894-accept.title: Bone Raising

92894-complete.name: Orgrul
92894-complete.text:
<Orgrul listens to your explanation, unable to suppress a grin.>

Do not fret, outsider, for this experiment was anything but a failure. We now know how weak and fragile the Gelkis' form of necromancy is. They have a long way to go before they will match our might.

The fact that you were able to seize control of any of them speaks highly of you, too. Despite those wasted skeletons, you have demonstrated your impressive capabilities.

I will take the staff for now. There is more work to do.
92894-complete.title: Bone Raising

93066-accept.name: Orgrul
93066-accept.text:
On the other side of the valley, we have established a small foothold to prepare to march into the forest nearby. Before you head straight there, I want you to deal with a recent Bristleback intrusion along the way. They seem to have arrived right around the same time we did, but managed to secure an artifact from the nearby temple that has kept us at bay.

This task is simple. Look for the thorns and the pigs. Kill a bunch, indiscriminately. Then report to Hagiak at the camp I mentioned.
93066-accept.title: Bristleback Retreat

93066-complete.name: Hagiak
93066-complete.text:
I am sorry you have come all this way, outsider, but you are not needed at the Magram front. Already you have distracted me long enough to delay our work.

Return to Orgrul and tell him--

On second thought, I do have something for a disposable soldier such as yourself. This will be quick, for better or worse.
93066-complete.title: Bristleback Retreat

93072-accept.name: Hagiak
93072-accept.text:
There is a second centaur village out here, to the southwest. That one belongs to the Gelkis. You expect me to send you over just to spill some blood, right? Good. That had best be your first thought, else I would cast doubt on your allegiance to the Magram!

What are you waiting for? Go! Kill!
93072-accept.title: Long-Term Solutions

93072-complete.name: Hagiak
93072-complete.text:
My scouts have already reported your success. Now perhaps we can continue our training in peace. The Gelkis need to learn that this place, and the Desolace, belong to centaur born of Magram blood.

If you see any stragglers, cut off their heads too. They should be afraid to ever step hoof outside of their little hovel.

That will belong to us too, someday soon.
93072-complete.title: Long-Term Solutions

93129-accept.name: Hagiak
93129-accept.text:
Since you seem overly eager to help our clan, I am sure you would be willing to fetch some supplies while you are over in the Outcast Hideaway.

Felling our foes should be enough motivation for a Magram, but I see no reason why we could not profit from the endeavor, too.

When we have the exiles dealt with, we can secure this place for the Magram and raise an army to bring the other clans to their knees!
93129-accept.title: Threat of Starvation

93129-complete.name: Hagiak
93129-complete.text:
<Hagiak peeks into several of the crates without a word at first.>

Of all things to bring out to the front lines, I would have never expected... nevermind. Some of these crates have food in them, and that's what matters. We've shortened the time they can survive here significantly.

The ultimate victory for our clan grows nearer.
93129-complete.title: Threat of Starvation

93129-progress.name: Hagiak
93129-progress.text: Slay their soldiers and starve the survivors. Their little hideaway should never be a sufficient staging ground against our clan again!
93129-progress.title: Threat of Starvation

93188-accept.name: Hagiak
93188-accept.text:
You have done enough on the front lines. We can handle ourselves.

Tell Orgrul that you have served your purpose. The Magram Front is stronger now, and we have our sights set on the outcast encampment as our next settlement when another fleet of fighters joins the fray.

Well? Get going!
93188-accept.title: Return to Orgrul

93188-complete.name: Orgrul
93188-complete.text:
An interesting development has unfolded within Magram Village during your brief absence. It was an act of war, carefully executed by an outsider fighting under the Gelkis banner.

Had this taken place a few months prior, I would have demanded execution of you and all other outsiders ignorantly playing deception with our clans.

But this is no ordinary circumstance.

This is an opportunity. For you, for the Magram, for the war.
93188-complete.title: Return to Orgrul

93196-accept.name: Orgrul
93196-accept.text:
The leader of our clan, Khan Jehn, was slain by a band of outsiders much like you. They were acting on behalf of the Gelkis Clan.

You can stop feigning your surprise. An assault on Magram Village while our attention was elsewhere is a predictable war strategy, especially for the Gelkis.

Do you know why I am showing no rage or remorse, outsider?

<Orgrul hands you a familiar weapon, imbued with even greater power than the last time you held it.>

This is why.
93196-accept.title: Khan Jehn

93196-complete.name: Khan Jehn
93196-complete.text:
The Gelkis recruit outsiders to perform underhanded war strategies, where our clan would send them off to die.

And yet, here you are, $N. An outsider who has demonstrated fierce loyalty to the Magram Clan despite being so unwelcome.

I do not know your motivations, but I recognize first-hand your potential. You have my gratitude, and that of our clan.

To us, you are no longer an outsider. To us, you are Magram.
93196-complete.title: Khan Jehn
